@rateLimit.summary: Field-level rate limit hint consumed when Hive Gateway `rateLimiting` is enabled (graphql-rate-limit style).

authors.intro: Import from `https://specs.graphql-mesh.dev/rate-limit/v0.1`. Enable rate limiting in Gateway config or the directive is inert.

implementers.compose: Hand `@link` + `@composeDirective(name: "@rateLimit")` so composition exposes the directive on the SG; preserve args.
implementers.runtime: Gateway rateLimiting plugin reads apps and enforces windows per identity key.

max.defaults: Optional Int; required for enforcement in practice.

identityArgs.constraints: Argument names included in the rate-limit identity key.
identityArgs.authors: Scope limits per argument values (e.g. per search query).
identityArgs.implementers: Hash into identity alongside viewer identity.

arrayLengthField.constraints: Argument name whose array length multiplies cost.
arrayLengthField.authors: Charge N tokens for array inputs of length N.
arrayLengthField.implementers: Multiply token cost by array length.
